config.craftable.server.direct_preparati:
Custom: use the conservative defaults and recipe overrides.
Allow all: allow direct preparation for supported, validated recipes.
Confirm all: every partial preparation needs confirmation.
Only applies to an explicit partial request; never bypasses world rules or safety checks. Switching modes preserves both override lists.

Custom mode only: allow these exact recipe IDs without an extra confirmation. Up to 128 full namespace:recipe IDs, each at most 128 characters. Unknown IDs are kept but cannot enable unsupported recipes. A confirmation override takes priority.

Custom mode only: require confirmation for these exact recipe IDs, including recipes allowed by default. Up to 128 full namespace:recipe IDs, each at most 128 characters. Takes priority if an ID appears in both lists.

screen.craftable.settings.direct.choices:
Default: inherit the conservative structural check
Allow: explicitly permit this recipe in Custom mode

screen.craftable.settings.direct.unsuppo: Unknown or not in the supported static crafting catalog. The stored ID is dormant; this setting cannot unlock it.

screen.craftable.settings.direct.help: Recipes are grouped by output item and sorted by exact ID. Each row is one recipe, not every way to produce the item. Default wood/storage conversions are checked structurally, not trusted by ID alone. Done keeps this draft; save on the World Rules page.

screen.craftable.settings.direct.default: Clear both override lists in this draft. This restores inheritance of the conservative defaults, not a list of blindly trusted IDs. The direct-preparation mode is unchanged.

config.craftable.server.partial_executio:
When materials are missing:
Off: disables partial preparation, not full crafting.
Confirm: requires reviewing the plan.
Safe: allows a double-press to make available materials; complex crafts still need confirmation.
Pressing the craft key once never makes only part of a recipe.
config.craftable.server.surplus_delivery:
Leftover items:
Fit: all items must fit in your inventory.
Drop: the items you set out to craft must still fit; only other leftover items that do not fit are dropped and may be lost.
Maximum executions of the target recipe per action; default 64, range 1–64. Crafting sticks once gives four sticks. Crafts used to make ingredients also count toward the separate step limit.
config.craftable.server.max_plan_steps.t: Counts every craft of the target and its ingredients. Default 128; range 1–256. Raising this does not increase time, memory or network size limits; complex crafts may still be unresolved.
config.craftable.client.partial_policy.t:
When materials are missing:
Off: disables partial preparation, not full crafting.
Confirm: requires reviewing the plan.
Safe: allows a double-press to make available materials; complex crafts still need confirmation.
Personal choices cannot loosen world restrictions.
config.craftable.client.allow_surplus_dr: When off, all items must fit in your inventory. When on, leftover items can only be dropped if the world settings allow it.
config.craftable.client.double_press_mil: Default 350; range 150–800. Release the key between presses; key repeat does not count.
